question: The area of a triangle is 84 cm². If the altitude corresponding to its base is two-thirds of the base length, find the length of the base.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the base of the triangle be b. The altitude is given as (2 ÷ 3) × b.

Area = 1/2 × b × altitude = 1/2 × b × (2 ÷ 3)b = b² ÷ 3

b² ÷ 3 = 84

b² = 84 × 3 = 252

b = √252 = √(36 × 7) = 6√7 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 6√7 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 

 
• 
 

 h = 2/3 b
 Base = b
 Area = 84 cm²

**Given:**

⇒ Area of the triangle = 84 cm²

⇒ Altitude (h) = 2/3 of Base (b)

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Area of a triangle = 1/2 × Base × Altitude

**Calculations:**

⇒ 84 = 1/2 × b × (2/3 × b)

⇒ 84 = 1/3 × b²

⇒ b² = 84 × 3

⇒ b² = 252

⇒ b = √252

⇒ b = √(36 × 7)

⇒ b = 6√7 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 6√7 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Equilateral Triangle Area

For a triangle with all sides equal to 'a', Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × a² and Height = (√3 ÷ 2) × a.

Heron's Formula for Any Triangle

If sides are a, b, and c with semi-perimeter s = (a + b + c) ÷ 2, Area = √[s × (s − a) × (s − b) × (s − c)].

Right Angled Triangle

Area = 1/2 × Base × Perpendicular, where the base and perpendicular are the sides adjacent to the 90-degree angle.
